_comment: REAL h-dcn membership_type integrity fixture (spec 03b BU-7, Task 7.1) — the committed
proof the all-tenant integrity scan (scripts/scan_membership_type_integrity.py) reads.
It is NOT a hand-built abstraction. Its three slices are the live h-dcn data:
1. field_options — the POST-FOLD `config#fields.membership.membership_type` option list,
REUSED verbatim from backend/tests/fixtures/hdcn_membership_type_options.json (the slice
committed in Task 1.3). The 7 values + {nl,en} labels + roles gates are the h-dcn
Lidmaatschap Beheer catalog documented in scripts/onboarding/members/h-dcn/ONBOARDING.md
and seeded by sam/members/migration/hdcn_catalog_seed.py (HDCN_MEMBERSHIP_TYPES). `erelid`
is the retired entry folded to allowed:false (design 'Migration-safety proof').
2. catalog_rows — the membershiptype#<code> catalog as it stands at fold time, in the
MembershipTypeEntry shape {tenant_id, type_code, label{nl,en}, active, order}. These are
the rows the EXPAND migration (Task 7.2) folds onto the field and CONTRACT (Task 10.1)
retires. `erelid` carries active:false — the one retired entry the design proof identifies.
3. member_tally — the authoritative count of stored member records by
membership.membership_type, from the design 'Migration-safety proof' run against the FULL
live h-dcn member population (1215 member# rows, complete query, no pagination, 2026-10-29).
gewoon_lid 936 + gezins_lid 200 + overig 57 + gezins_donateur 17 + erelid 4 + donateur 1
= 1215. `sponsor` has 0 members (an offered option nobody has picked — harmless).
The scan asserts, against these real slices: (a) every ACTIVE catalog type_code appears as a
field option value (zero un-folded catalog rows), and (b) every member-held value resolves to
a field option INCLUDING the grandfathered erelid=allowed:false (zero orphaned references).
